# Non-rm sudo invocations
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y nginx
sudo systemctl restart docker
sudo chown jadb:staff file
# rm without recursion
sudo rm /tmp/file
sudo rm -f /tmp/file
# Non-pipe curl/wget
sudo curl https://example.com -o /etc/file
sudo wget -O /etc/file https://example.com
# Strings inside quotes cannot be distinguished from real commands by
# the regex matcher; harmless echoes that mention 'sudo rm -rf' will
# match. This is intentional — a stricter matcher would need a shell
# parser.
